scope: Reconstruction from supplied operator report and archived release contract; not a raw agent transcript.

operator_report.title: Formal v8 research visualization
operator_report.status: Operator-supplied aggregates, sample descriptions and telemetry; receipts were not attached.

release_contract.retrieval_note: Rechecked through the GitHub API against the current release branch at the pinned commit on 2026-09-09; instruction.md matches the archived copy byte-for-byte.

proxy_warning: Operator telemetry describes non-unanimous-group fraction; release contract defines 4p(1-p). These are distinct quantities.

observed_sample_descriptions.title: Exact arithmetic, with the answer recomputed
observed_sample_descriptions.description: The report describes a sum of sixteen 13-digit numbers. An independent calculation checks the answer from the rendered question.
observed_sample_descriptions.interpretation: A reliable label makes correctness testable; arithmetic alone does not cover the breadth of mathematical reasoning.

observed_sample_descriptions.title: Wrong options that resist shortcuts
observed_sample_descriptions.description: Four arithmetic options share mod-9 and mod-11 checks and the same last six digits. Those modular checks and trailing digits cannot distinguish the options.
observed_sample_descriptions.interpretation: The generator tries to remove shortcuts. It still needs held-out evidence to show transfer to broad knowledge questions.

observed_sample_descriptions.title: Several constraints in one response
observed_sample_descriptions.description: A prompt combines an exact paragraph count, a required first word, and repeated-keyword rules. The fixed checker scores compliance.
observed_sample_descriptions.interpretation: The constraints make the task verifiable. They do not establish that the response is otherwise useful or well written.

observed_sample_descriptions.title: Find and combine scattered information
observed_sample_descriptions.description: Sixteen target readings are spread across a 300-entry station log of roughly 44,000 characters. The answer is recomputed from the log.
observed_sample_descriptions.interpretation: Success requires retrieval plus aggregation. One synthetic log family cannot establish general long-context ability.

observed_sample_descriptions.title: A small program with executable tests
observed_sample_descriptions.description: A string-normalization task specifies nine ordered operations. An independent reference implementation passes all 24 supplied tests.
observed_sample_descriptions.interpretation: Tests make the reward concrete. Passing a finite test suite is evidence of correctness, not an exhaustive proof.

limits: No repeat training seeds or confidence intervals

shared_base.role: Provided common half of both training arms

baseline_pool.role: Provided fixed comparison half; called Baseline on the card

candidate_pool.role: New verifiable RL tasks generated and selected by the research agent; not included in the released fixed pools

data_provenance.format: Prompts with domain-specific labels or grading contracts for fixed GRPO training; not a supervised full-solution training submission.

compute_budget.source: Operator-provided five-domain budget dated 2026-09-07; the existing website records the equivalence convention in commit bad6be8386148660b24bad164920111cd8111895.
compute_budget.interpretation: Planning/accounting estimate for exploration plus one final standard run, not measured H100 runtime; excludes a separately rerun comparison arm.
